hooks.command: [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/agent-command-guard.ts" ] || { echo "This checkout has no command guard, so the command runs unchecked." >&2; exit 0; }; node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/agent-command-guard.ts" || { echo "The command guard did not run, so the command is refused." >&2; exit 2; }

[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/solid2-agent-kit/bin/solid2-kit.mjs" ] || { echo "The Solid 2 kit is not installed, so its hook does not run." >&2; exit 0; }; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && node node_modules/solid2-agent-kit/bin/solid2-kit.mjs hook claude; status=$?; [ $status -eq 0 ] || [ $status -eq 2 ] || { echo "The Solid 2 kit's hook did not run, so it is taken as a failed check." >&2; exit 2; }; exit $status
